ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

HeroTitle.helper: Required. This becomes the main H1 for the section.

HeroLead.helper: Required. Keep this to a short paragraph for best layout results.
HeroLead.placeholder: Explore the scientific foundations and practical preparations for your journey back to the natural world.

EyebrowText.helper: Optional. A short label shown above the main heading.

Cta1Text.helper: Optional. Button text for the primary call to action.

Cta1Icon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

Cta1Url.helper: Optional. Full web addresses or relative page path for button 1.

Cta2Text.helper: Optional. Button text for the secondary call to action.

Cta2Icon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

Cta2Url.helper: Optional. Full web addresses or relative page path for button 2.

HeroImage.helper: Required. Uploads should go to Content/Heros/. Recommended minimum size: 1200 x 1500 px. Use a strong vertical or portrait-friendly image. Keep important visual content centered, since the image may crop differently by screen size.

HeroImageQuote.helper: Required. Short pull-quote shown overlapping the image. Best kept to one or two short lines.
HeroImageQuote.placeholder: Nature is the original architect of high-performing systems.
